Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear first. Taking successive ability hits stacks Brand P Blaze until it explodes, and Brand Q Sear stuns you if you are ablaze. If you are ablaze, move out of the projectile's path or hide behind minions.
Brand.build: Prioritize magic resistance when choosing defensive items. Brand's main damage and Brand P Blaze deal magic damage, and stacking only maximum health also increases the damage from Brand P Blaze. Movement speed helps you leave telegraphed areas.
Brand.fight: The moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is used is your opening. Approach from the side with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then lock Brand down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. With no mobility ability, Brand will struggle to escape. If you are ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear before engaging.
Brand.laning: During early jungle clears, focus on Amumu E Tantrum and use Amumu W Despair briefly to save mana. Brand E Conflagration can spread around burning minions, so do not engage while standing right next to the wave.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is used and you have an angle from the side, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attacks. If Amumu Q Bandage Toss lands, use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy while Brand is stunned.
Brand.escape: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame being used as your signal to engage. If you are ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear before going in. If Brand Q Sear has also been used, Brand has fewer ways to respond once you close in. Brand has no mobility ability, so close the gap and lock Brand down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Brand.phase: Mid to late game teamfights are Amumu's strong point, but spread out before engaging to avoid Brand's area damage.
Brand.teamfight: Brand E Conflagration spreads around burning targets, and Brand R Pyroclasm bounces between enemies, so spread out from your allies before engaging. Wait out of vision on the flank, then engage toward Brand and lock down multiple enemies with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. After engaging, keep Amumu W Despair active and stay among the frontliners to maintain damage and the curse.

Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and lowers resistances, so be careful not to let Briar get close. When Briar starts charging Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, and do not fight with your back to a wall. Briar R Certain Death targets the first champion its bloodstone hits, so stand in front of your backline damage dealers.
Briar.build: Prioritize armor to withstand Briar's main damage. Briar Q Head Rush lowers resistances, so do not rely solely on defensive stats; avoid getting hit. In fights extended by healing, build Morellonomicon between core items and maintain Grievous Wounds with Amumu W Despair.
Briar.fight: Rather than taking a long duel alone, counter Briar's engage with your allies. When Briar jumps in with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, block the path from the front and lock Briar down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to give your allies time to attack. Once close, activate Amumu W Despair and use Amumu E Tantrum.
Briar.laning: During early jungle clears, focus on Amumu E Tantrum and use Amumu W Despair briefly to save mana. Amumu loses a lot of health on the first clear, so do not force an invade against Briar.
Briar.combo: When engaging Briar, land Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks in that order. Do not use both charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss back to back; save one to catch Briar again after a move with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Briar.escape: Before Briar R Certain Death comes back up, you have an opening to engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If only Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack has been used, Briar may still have another way to move, so do not engage hastily. You can interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream with Amumu's stun as Briar starts charging it.
Briar.phase: Early on, Briar tends to have high kill participation and overcommit, so establish vision and look for counterattack opportunities. In the mid to late game, join teamfights and do not fight alone in a side lane.
Briar.teamfight: Stand on the front line so Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack or Briar R Certain Death does not target your backline carries. If Briar dives an allied carry, using Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down one target is also a good option. Engage in a narrow passage near an objective when your team is ready to follow up, then stay among the frontliners with Amumu W Despair active.

Ekko.watch: When the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence appears, leave its area so Ekko does not get the stun and shield. Step away from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder as well. When Ekko's afterimage is visible, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not overcommit to a chase even when health is low.
Ekko.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Ekko's damage. To counter the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak, build Morellonomicon between core items and maintain Grievous Wounds with Amumu W Despair.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, lock Ekko down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If only Ekko E Phase Dive has been used, Ekko can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so do not chase too far.
Ekko.laning: During early jungle clears, focus on Amumu E Tantrum and use Amumu W Despair briefly to save mana.
Ekko.combo: When Ekko R Chronobreak has been used, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and immediately use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to chain the stuns. Follow with Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks. Do not use both charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss at once; if Ekko escapes with Ekko E Phase Dive, catch Ekko again with the remaining charge.
Ekko.escape: When the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence appears, leave its area first. It is safer to engage after Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak have been used. If Ekko has also used Ekko E Phase Dive, you have an opening to lock Ekko down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Ekko.phase: In the mid to late game, focus on teamfights and do not fight Ekko alone in a side lane.
Ekko.teamfight: Establish vision in the narrow passages around dragon or Baron, and look to use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy when Ekko and other enemies group up. If Ekko reaches an allied damage dealer with Ekko E Phase Dive, immediately locking Ekko down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is also worthwhile. Engage when your allies are ready to follow up, then remain among the frontliners with Amumu W Despair active.

Elise.watch: If Elise E Cocoon hits, she can follow up with Elise R Spider Form attacks while you are stunned. Keep a minion or jungle monster between you and her to avoid it. If Elise switches to Elise R Spider Form after health has decreased, she is looking for a finishing blow, so be ready to respond with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise's main ability damage, and get armor for her basic attack damage. If the healing from Elise P Spider Queen is a problem, fit Morellonomicon between core items and use Amumu W Despair to keep Grievous Wounds applied.
Elise.fight: Avoid solo fights early. Close the gap after Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is used. Once you connect with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, turn on Amumu W Despair and weave in basic attacks to maintain Amumu P Cursed Touch.
Elise.laning: Your first jungle clear costs a lot of health, so avoid risky invades. Turn off Amumu W Despair while moving to save mana. Keep ample vision so Elise's early ganks do not net her a kill.
Elise.combo: Close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss after Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite or Elise E Rappel is used. Follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → a basic attack. Instead of using both Amumu Q Bandage Toss charges back to back, catch Elise again with the second after she moves.
Elise.escape: Once both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel have been used, you have a chance to counterengage. Catch her with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy immediately after she uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, too.
Elise.phase: In the mid and late game, Amumu's teamfighting grows stronger as he gains items. Move with your team instead of fighting alone.
Elise.teamfight: Establish vision in narrow paths around objectives. When enemies group up and your team can follow, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Flash, then use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. You can use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy on Elise alone if it will reliably lock her down while she attacks an allied carry. After engaging, turn on Amumu W Despair and stay near enemies to maintain damage and the curse.

Fiddlesticks.watch: If you see Fiddlesticks channeling Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, interrupt it with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If you cannot interrupt it, leave its area. When Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, watch brush without vision and narrow paths.
Fiddlesticks.build: Build magic resistance against Fiddlesticks’ damage, and prioritize tenacity to reduce how long you’re affected by Terrify and silence. If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest’s healing is a problem, fit Morellonomicon between your core items and use Amumu W Despair to keep the Grievous Wounds effect active.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Early on, manage your health while clearing jungle camps and avoid risky invades.
Fiddlesticks.combo: After closing in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → a basic attack. If you need to interrupt the channel of Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm or Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, save Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy for it.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the mid and late game, look for teamfights with your allies and avoid fighting alone in a side lane.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Establish vision around objectives first to watch for paths Fiddlesticks could use to engage from brush with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Keep some distance from your allies so his area abilities do not hit you together, and interrupt his channel with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy when it starts. When engaging, land Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy once your allies are ready to follow, then turn on Amumu W Despair and stay among the enemies.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If you engage while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, his mobility tool, is unavailable, escape becomes difficult after a catch. Amumu has no escape ability of his own, so do not engage first when you are close enough to be hit by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap in succession.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. Keep your distance: if Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, you can take damage in succession. While Gragas R Explosive Cask is available, do not stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.
Gragas.build: Gragas can sustain himself with Gragas P Happy Hour, so fit Morellonomicon between core items. Build magic resistance over armor against his main ability damage. Get movement speed to escape the barrel's radius.
Gragas.fight: When Gragas starts drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage, hold your burst and attack after its effect ends. Right after you force him to use Gragas E Body Slam, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and lock him down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Turn on Amumu W Despair during the fight to deal ongoing damage around you.
Gragas.laning: Clear the early jungle primarily with Amumu E Tantrum, and use Amumu W Despair only briefly to save mana. Your first clear costs a lot of health, so avoid risky invades.
Gragas.combo: If Gragas E Body Slam is unavailable, use Amumu Q Bandage Toss → Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → a basic attack. If Gragas E Body Slam is still available, do not use both Amumu Q Bandage Toss charges back to back. Use the first to close in and the second when he tries to escape.
Gragas.escape: Right after you draw out Gragas E Body Slam is your chance to close the gap. Chain Amumu Q Bandage Toss into Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to stop him escaping. If Gragas R Explosive Cask is still available, check which direction it could knock you before engaging.
Gragas.phase: Gragas has strong burst and can disrupt formations in the early and mid game, but his sustained damage is weaker late. Hold your formation in early and mid game objective fights, and look for teamfights in the mid and late game.
Gragas.teamfight: From a flank outside enemy vision, check that your allies are ready to follow, then stun grouped enemies with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Keep your backline from standing alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam. If you can lock down an enemy attacking an allied carry with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, take that opportunity. After engaging, turn on Amumu W Despair and stay among the frontliners to maintain damage and the curse.

Evelynn.watch: When the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, back away before the charm completes and alert your team. At low health, Evelynn R Last Caress can finish you off, so do not stay in areas where you have no vision.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn's main damage. Evelynn W Allure lowers magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone. If she sustains herself with Evelynn P Demon Shade, fit Morellonomicon between core items.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance before the mark from Evelynn W Allure fully develops. If you can anticipate her approach, use Amumu E Tantrum to check nearby. When allies can follow, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and lock her down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy instead of fighting alone.
Evelynn.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health while clearing early, so do not force an invade into Evelynn's jungle. When ganking, approach from the river or brush for a side angle on Amumu Q Bandage Toss so minions do not block it. Turn off Amumu W Despair while moving.
Evelynn.combo: Hit Evelynn with Amumu Q Bandage Toss to close in, then follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → a basic attack. If she creates distance with Evelynn E Whiplash, catch her again with the second Amumu Q Bandage Toss charge you saved.
Evelynn.escape: Do not force an engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is unavailable; she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress. In particular, before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, avoid the charm from Evelynn W Allure, then engage alongside your team with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Evelynn.teamfight: If Evelynn dives a backline carry, protect them by locking her down with the Amumu Q Bandage Toss charge you saved or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. In narrow objective terrain, wait on a flank outside enemy vision, then engage on grouped enemies when your allies can follow. After engaging, turn on Amumu W Despair and stay near the enemy frontline to deal damage.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits a wall, so avoid fighting with your back to one. If Graves W Smoke Screen hits you, leave its area by the shortest route, then close in again.
Graves.build: Graves deals primarily physical damage, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Armor will not reduce the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.fight: Counterattack when Graves has fired both shots and is reloading. His basic attacks stop at the first unit they hit, so fight with an ally or minion between you and him. If he escapes with Graves E Quickdraw, close in again with your saved second Amumu Q Bandage Toss charge.
Graves.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health on his first jungle clear, so do not force an invade toward Graves.
Graves.combo: Close in and stun with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and a basic attack, in that order. If Graves can escape with Graves E Quickdraw or Graves R Collateral Damage, use the two charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss separately.
Graves.escape: If you engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down, he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage. In particular, before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up, leave the smoke, then lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Graves.teamfight: Establish vision around the objective first. When the enemy groups in a narrow passage, engage from the side and stun multiple targets with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately against a wall, so do not take a fight with your back to one. After engaging, keep Amumu W Despair on and stay near the frontline.

Hecarim.watch: The farther Hecarim travels with Hecarim E Devastating Charge, the more damage and knockback it deals. If he turns and starts running, move toward your allies or break vision. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear grouped allies at once, so spread out in teamfights. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, fighting near him for longer helps him heal, so look for a chance to retreat out of its range.
Hecarim.build: Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. If the healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is a problem, fit Morellonomicon between your core items. The damage over time from Amumu W Despair can keep Grievous Wounds applied to multiple enemies.
Hecarim.fight: When engaging, lock down Hecarim's movement first with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Amumu has no ability to escape on his own, so go in when your allies can follow up.
Hecarim.laning: Clear your early jungle camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, and turn on Amumu W Despair only briefly during fights and clears to conserve mana. Avoid risky invades on your first clear, taking the health cost of that clear into account.
Hecarim.combo: Your standard engage is Amumu Q Bandage Toss → Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → activate Amumu W Despair → basic attack. Do not use both charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss right away. If Hecarim escapes with Hecarim E Devastating Charge or Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, catch him again with the remaining charge.
Hecarim.escape: Do not engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up, especially when Hecarim E Devastating Charge is also down, you have a chance to lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Go in when your allies are ready to follow up.
Hecarim.phase: Amumu is weak in a solo fight, so do not fight Hecarim alone in a side lane.
Hecarim.teamfight: Allies should spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows cannot fear several of them. Once your allies are ready to follow up, engage from an unseen flank or a narrow passage near an objective with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Hecarim dives your carry, using Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down Hecarim alone may be more valuable than trying to catch several enemies.

Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller hits you, his allies can dash in, so keep your distance and position minions or terrain between you and him before he fires it. Do not engage a target with Ivern E Triggerseed on them right away; wait for the shield to burst and the slow to end. If Daisy starts attacking you, reposition to avoid the knockup from three consecutive attacks.
Ivern.fight: Close the distance right after Ivern Q Rootcaller is used, then engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. If the target already has Ivern E Triggerseed on them, delay your engage until the shield bursts. Once in range, use basic attacks and Amumu W Despair to keep the curse applied and deal damage.
Ivern.laning: Clear the early jungle mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, and use Amumu W Despair briefly to conserve mana. Watch for ambushes near brush Ivern has created, and use vision of his early jungle to read his camp harvesting route.
Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has detonated, use Amumu Q Bandage Toss → Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attack. If Ivern moves after the first Amumu Q Bandage Toss, catch him again with the second.
Ivern.escape: Amumu has no ability to escape on his own, so engage right after you dodge or force out Ivern Q Rootcaller. If a target has Ivern E Triggerseed on them, wait until the shield bursts and the slow ends.
Ivern.teamfight: Take an unseen flank near a narrow passage around an objective. When your allies are ready to follow up, lock down grouped enemies with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Ivern R Daisy! can take a skill hit at the front, so check which enemy Amumu Q Bandage Toss will hit first. After engaging, activate Amumu W Despair and stay among the frontliners. Instead of chasing Ivern deep, stop the allies he is protecting.
Ivern.build: Tenacity is a good early choice against Ivern because allies joining in following the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knock-up from Ivern R Daisy! poses a risk. If you build resistances afterward, choose magic resistance over armor. Movement speed is also useful for leaving a telegraphed area.

JarvanIV.build: Basic attacks and attack speed are also key sources of damage, so reducing attack speed is effective.
JarvanIV.fight: Once in range, activate Amumu W Despair and keep dealing damage with Amumu E Tantrum and basic attacks.
JarvanIV.laning: Amumu spends health and mana on his early jungle clear, so do not force an invade on your first clear. Turn off Amumu W Despair while moving.
JarvanIV.teamfight: After engaging, activate Amumu W Despair and stay near the enemy front line.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so walk out of its marked blast area and, when possible, overlap your position with an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain lowers your magic resistance and slows you, so go around it. After killing Karthus, move away from his body immediately to avoid Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile during Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.build: Karthus deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. Prioritize movement speed too, so you can avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and quickly leave the range of Karthus E Defile.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own, so landing Amumu Q Bandage Toss gives you a chance to catch him. Approach from the side to avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain, then turn on Amumu W Despair once you reach him to keep dealing damage.
Karthus.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health while clearing the jungle early, so do not force a solo invade. Turn off Amumu W Despair while moving to save mana.
Karthus.combo: After reaching Karthus with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attacks. Follow up with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy while Karthus is stunned immediately after Amumu Q Bandage Toss lands.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own. Engage when you have an angle for Amumu Q Bandage Toss without walking through Karthus W Wall of Pain. If Karthus is behind minions, circle to the side and engage when you have an angle instead of throwing Amumu Q Bandage Toss from the front.
Karthus.phase: Amumu has more impact in teamfights by the mid and late game, but Karthus can also scale through fast farming. Move with your team instead of fighting alone.

Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are negated and its recast can stun you in an area, so move out of range. Even after Jax closes in with Jax Q Leap Strike, do not basic attack until Jax E Counter Strike ends.
Jax.build: Prioritize considering items that reduce attack speed to counter Jax's basic attacks and attack speed. Build both armor and magic resistance to account for the physical damage from Jax Q Leap Strike and the magic damage from Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike.
Jax.fight: Keep your distance to avoid the stun while Jax E Counter Strike is active, then fight using your abilities after it ends. Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is a chance to catch him with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Jax.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health during early jungle clears, so avoid forced invades and turn off Amumu W Despair while moving to save mana.
Jax.combo: If Jax E Counter Strike has ended and Jax has used Jax Q Leap Strike, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Then use Amumu E Tantrum, turn on Amumu W Despair, and basic attack. If Jax Q Leap Strike is still available, save the next cast of Amumu Q Bandage Toss to catch him again after he leaps.
Jax.escape: Right after you force Jax to use Jax Q Leap Strike is your window to close the gap with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Engage after Jax E Counter Strike has been used and its stun has ended, then lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun. As soon as the stun ends, lock Jax down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. You can also use your ultimate to stop Jax alone if he is attacking an allied damage dealer. After engaging, turn on Amumu W Despair and stay near the enemy frontline.

LeeSin.watch: Dodge the first hit of Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike. If health decreases after it hits, move toward your allies: the second hit is more dangerous because its damage scales with missing health. Watch for room for Lee Sin to get behind you and use Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first against Lee Sin's main damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If Lee Sin sustains through long fights with the omnivamp from Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, consider healing reduction.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid solo duels with Lee Sin early. Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss when your allies can fight with you, then lock him down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Once in range, turn on Amumu W Despair, use Amumu E Tantrum, and stay near the frontline.
LeeSin.laning: Your first jungle clear costs a lot of health, so do not force a fight against a Lee Sin invade. Clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, and turn off Amumu W Despair while moving to save mana.
LeeSin.combo: Use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy right after closing in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then follow with Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks. If Lee Sin escapes with Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, catch him again with your saved second Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
LeeSin.escape: The window to engage is before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back. Lee Sin can also move with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, so do not spend both Amumu Q Bandage Toss casts just because he used one mobility ability. Once his mobility abilities are down, lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off if you run into him. Later, Lee Sin falls off and Amumu becomes more valuable in teamfights. Take objectives and lane advantages to buy time.
LeeSin.teamfight: Establish vision in the narrow paths around objectives. When your allies are ready to follow, engage from the side and lock down grouped enemies with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Lee Sin dives your carry, it is better to make sure you lock him down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy than to aim for multiple targets. Just before a teamfight, keep some distance between allies so Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage does not hit you together.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so save your stun until he lands. When Master Yi E Wuju Style is active, his basic attacks include true damage, and slows do not work during Master Yi R Highlander. Do not take hits for a long time while trying to create distance. Master Yi can quickly reach another target after a takedown, so keep allies from getting caught alone.
MasterYi.build: Use health to withstand the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, and get a way to reduce attack speed. If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate is a problem, build Morellonomicon between core items and maintain Grievous Wounds with Amumu W Despair.
MasterYi.fight: Engage when your allies can attack with you instead of fighting Master Yi alone for a long time. Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
MasterYi.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health while jungling early, so do not force an invade on your first clear. While Master Yi's early ganks are weak, take gank and objective opportunities with your allies.
MasterYi.combo: When Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attacks. Do not use both Amumu Q Bandage Toss casts in succession. Save one for Master Yi's next move or to interrupt Master Yi W Meditate.
MasterYi.escape: Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is used is your window to engage. Wait for him to land, then stun him with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy and attack with your allies.
MasterYi.phase: Both champions are weak in the jungle early, so Amumu should avoid forced solo invades and look for gank and objective opportunities. Master Yi grows stronger as the game goes on, so do not put off advantages you can take early.
MasterYi.teamfight: Stay grouped with your allies to deny Master Yi his first takedown. Watch for him to land from Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to give your allies time to attack.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so stay out of its range. If he closes in and Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, the damage trade turns against you.
MonkeyKing.build: Wukong deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, so take care to avoid its empowered basic attack. If Wukong sustains through Wukong P Stone Skin, build Morellonomicon between core items and keep Grievous Wounds applied with Amumu W Despair.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin stacks armor and healing the longer a fight lasts, so keep solo trades short. Amumu’s main damage is magic damage, which works well against Wukong, so you can fight back when he closes in. Do not use Amumu Q Bandage Toss on the stationary clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster; watch where the real Wukong retreats.
MonkeyKing.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health during early jungle clears, so do not force an invade on your first clear. Clear camps with Amumu E Tantrum, and use Amumu W Despair only briefly during fights and jungle clears to save mana.
MonkeyKing.combo: Hit the real Wukong with Amumu Q Bandage Toss to close in, then follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks. Do not use both charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss in quick succession; save one to catch Wukong again after he escapes with Wukong W Warrior Trickster or Wukong E Nimbus Strike.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window to engage is after Wukong uses Wukong W Warrior Trickster and before it comes back. Check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, then lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Right after Wukong has fully spent Wukong R Cyclone is also a good time to start a fight or contest an objective.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the mid to late game, Amumu is strongest in teamfights once he has items, but avoid extended solo fights with Wukong in a side lane.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong dives an allied damage dealer, it is fine to use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down Wukong alone. When starting a fight, engage from an unseen flank by a narrow passage after confirming your team is ready to follow, then stay near the enemy frontline with Amumu W Despair active.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more from farther away, so step out of the spear’s path and keep minions or your allied frontline between you and Nidalee. Stepping on Nidalee W Bushwhack or getting hit by a spear applies a Hunted mark, so check river and jungle entrances. If Nidalee jumps in with Nidalee W Pounce after you are marked, Nidalee Q Takedown follows; save Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy for that moment.
Nidalee.build: If Nidalee sustains with Nidalee E Primal Surge, build Morellonomicon between core items. Build magic resistance before armor against Nidalee’s damage, but dodge long-range Nidalee Q Javelin Toss by repositioning.
Nidalee.fight: Make Nidalee use Nidalee W Pounce before closing in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. If the first charge connects, save the second to catch her again when she escapes with a mobility skill. Once close, activate Amumu W Despair and weave in basic attacks to maintain the curse.
Nidalee.laning: On the first jungle clear, clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly to save mana. Because the early clear costs a lot of health, avoid risky invades. Check for Nidalee W Bushwhack at river and jungle entrances with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability.
Nidalee.combo: After Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and extend the stun with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Then use Amumu E Tantrum, activate Amumu W Despair, and add basic attacks. If Nidalee can still use Pounce, do not use both Q charges in quick succession; save the second for pursuit.
Nidalee.escape: Right after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to close the gap. Nidalee has no crowd control, so approach while dodging spears and traps, then catch her with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy while Pounce is down.
Nidalee.phase: In the mid to late game, focus on teamfights and avoid fighting Nidalee alone in a side lane.
Nidalee.teamfight: Establish vision in narrow passages around objectives and watch where Nidalee steps out to throw spears. When your team is ready to follow, hit grouped enemies with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Nidalee dives an allied damage dealer with Nidalee W Pounce, it is also fine to use it to lock down Nidalee alone. After engaging, stay among the frontline with Amumu W Despair active to keep dealing damage and applying the curse.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! comes in from long range and knocks you up. Amumu has no ability to escape on his own, leaving him vulnerable to follow-up crowd control. When you see the snowball, do not just run backward; dodge toward the ground Nunu & Willump has already passed. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, reposition immediately to avoid the ensuing root.
Nunu.build: Build Morellonomicon early between core items to counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Keeping nearby enemies under Amumu W Despair’s damage helps maintain healing reduction on multiple targets. Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and consider tenacity against their crowd control.
Nunu.fight: Nunu & Willump can heal with Nunu & Willump Q Consume, so apply healing reduction before fighting alongside your team. Once close, activate Amumu W Despair for damage based on maximum health and add area damage with Amumu E Tantrum. If Nunu & Willump begins channeling Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero, interrupt it with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Nunu.laning: On Amumu’s first jungle clear, avoid risky invades and clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum. Activate Amumu W Despair only during fights or jungle clears so you have mana left for ganks.
Nunu.combo: When you have an opening to engage Nunu & Willump, close in and stun with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then immediately use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Follow with Amumu E Tantrum, activate Amumu W Despair, and weave in basic attacks. If you need to interrupt Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero, save Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy for that moment.
Nunu.escape: The chance to engage comes after you avoid the crowd control from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so if you catch them with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to keep them locked down. Amumu also has no ability to escape on his own, so engage only when your team can follow.
Nunu.phase: In the mid to late game, look for teamfights with your allies in narrow terrain and avoid fighting alone in a side lane.
Nunu.teamfight: Establish vision in the narrow passages around the dragon pit or Baron area. When enemies group up, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt the channel with Amumu’s stun. After engaging, stay near the frontline with Amumu W Despair active to deal damage and maintain the curse.

Poppy.fight: Keep your back away from walls, manage your distance, and wait for Poppy W Steadfast Presence to end. Once Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and lock her down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. After closing in, turn on Amumu W Despair and weave in basic attacks to maintain the curse.
Poppy.laning: Amumu needs to manage health and mana during his early jungle clear, so do not force an invade on the first clear. Clear camps with Amumu E Tantrum, and turn on Amumu W Despair only during fights and while clearing camps.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Immediately chain the stun with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, then use Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attacks for more damage and curse uptime. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is still available, do not use both casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss back to back; save one to reengage.
Poppy.phase: In the mid to late game, look for teamfights with your allies and do not fight Poppy alone in a side lane.
Poppy.teamfight: Wait on a flank outside enemy vision, then engage when Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and enemies group up in a narrow area. When your allies are ready to follow up, use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down multiple enemies. If Poppy is on an allied damage dealer, reliably locking down Poppy alone is also an option. After engaging, keep Amumu W Despair on and stay near the frontline to maintain maximum health damage and the curse.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage sources: Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. Don't spend extra resources on magic resistance just to face Poppy.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance. If Poppy starts charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, first move to the side from in front of her.
Poppy.watch: Stand on the open side, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, walk out of the area before the second hit detonates. While Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict is charging, sidestep out of its path.

Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, keep minions between you and him, and stay outside the range of Rammus E Frenzying Taunt. When Rammus rolls in quickly and uses Rammus R Soaring Slam, allow plenty of room around its area to dodge it, and immediately move away from its landing spot as well.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. Amumu has no ability to escape on his own, so if crowd control keeps you locked down, you can prioritize tenacity over magic resistance. The source does not name a specific item to buy.
Rammus.fight: Back off briefly when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, then focus your damage after it ends. When fighting up close, maintain the maximum health damage from Amumu W Despair, but avoid basic attacks during Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl because they trigger reflected damage.
Rammus.laning: Clear the early jungle mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, and use Amumu W Despair in short bursts to conserve mana. The first clear costs a lot of health, so do not force an invade toward Rammus.
Rammus.combo: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, immediately use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, then follow with Amumu E Tantrum and Amumu W Despair. Weave in basic attacks only after confirming Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is off. Save the second cast of Amumu Q Bandage Toss to catch Rammus again if he escapes with Rammus R Soaring Slam.
Rammus.escape: While Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, Rammus has no movement ability to escape, giving you a chance to engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, there is less risk of being unable to act immediately after closing in.
Rammus.phase: Amumu's teamfight impact grows in the mid to late game, but his solo fighting is weak, so do not fight alone.
Rammus.teamfight: Once your allies are ready to follow up, lock down multiple enemies with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy from an unseen flank or a narrow passage. If Rammus is on an allied damage dealer, it may be more valuable to use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down Rammus for certain than to wait for multiple targets. After engaging, turn on Amumu W Despair and stay near the frontline, but avoid basic attacks during Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush, so when Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and secure vision. When Rengar's resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike can root and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so do not start a damage trade then. To account for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, do not travel alone at low health.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt reduces armor, and Rengar W Battle Roar heals him. If that healing becomes a problem in fights, buy Morellonomicon between core items.
Rengar.fight: Trade damage when Rengar's resource bar is empty. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, catch him with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, then focus your damage. If Rengar leaps onto an allied damage dealer, countering with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is also good.
Rengar.laning: Early jungle camps cost a lot of health, so avoid forced invades. Clear mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, and turn on Amumu W Despair only during fights and while clearing camps to conserve mana.
Rengar.combo: If Rengar W Battle Roar is down, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks, in that order.
Rengar.escape: Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike and engage while Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Once Rengar is in close range, he has no ability to create distance on his own, so lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Rengar.phase: In the mid to late game, teamfights with items are Amumu's strength, so fight alongside your allies instead of facing Rengar alone.
Rengar.teamfight: Position your team so allied damage dealers stand behind the frontline and within vision, and watch for Rengar's leap. If Rengar jumps an allied damage dealer, counter by locking him down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. In narrow passages around objectives, engage when your allies are ready to follow up, then keep Amumu W Despair on while staying among the enemies.

RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai goes underground with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, watch the ground beneath you, leave narrow paths, and move toward open space. If you dodge the knockup as she emerges, Rek'Sai loses her way to catch you. Right after Rek'Sai damages you, Rek'Sai R Void Rush may follow, so stay close to your allies.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush scales with maximum health, so do not focus only on stacking health. If Rek'Sai sustains through Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, buy Morellonomicon between core items and maintain healing reduction with the damage over time from Amumu W Despair.
RekSai.fight: Do not fight Rek'Sai alone early. If Rek'Sai engages with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, dodge the knockup, then look for a chance to fight.
RekSai.laning: On the first jungle clear, account for the health cost and avoid forced invades. Clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum. To conserve mana, turn off Amumu W Despair while moving and use it only during fights and while clearing camps. To avoid giving up a kill to Rek'Sai's early ganks, do not cross areas without vision alone, and step on visible tunnels as you pass to destroy them.
RekSai.combo: Close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, lock Rek'Sai down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, then use Amumu E Tantrum and Amumu W Despair before adding basic attacks. Use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy before Amumu E Tantrum so your allies can attack during the stun. If Rek'Sai escapes with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush, catch her again with the saved second cast of Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
RekSai.escape: Look for a chance to engage after dodging the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so do not rush in. In particular, land Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy before Rek'Sai R Void Rush comes back up.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Amumu loses a lot of health and Rek'Sai has strong ganks, so clear the jungle without giving up kills. In the mid to late game, teamfights are a strength for Amumu with items, so group with your allies instead of fighting Rek'Sai alone in a side lane.
RekSai.teamfight: Set up vision in narrow passages around objectives. When Rek'Sai and the other enemies group up, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Flash and use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Rek'Sai engages on an allied damage dealer, it is also good to lock down Rek'Sai alone with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy instead of waiting to catch multiple enemies. Engage when your allies can follow up, then keep Amumu W Despair on near the frontline to maintain damage and the curse.

Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison can lead to an area stun, so dodge sideways when you see their windups. If the first hit of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath lands, move out of range before the second hit, which carries most of its damage and slow. Also back away immediately when hits from nearby enemies start building Sejuani E Permafrost stacks.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani’s main damage. Amumu has no ability to escape on his own, so you can prioritize tenacity if Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison lock you down in succession.
Sejuani.fight: Close the gap right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used; she then cannot dash away. Once in range, deal maximum health damage with Amumu W Despair, weaving in basic attacks and Amumu E Tantrum.
Sejuani.laning: For your early jungle clear, rely on Amumu E Tantrum and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly to save mana. Do not force an invade into Sejuani's jungle on your first clear.
Sejuani.combo: If Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and immediately use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Follow with Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks, in that order. If you engage while Sejuani still has her dash, save the second cast of Amumu Q Bandage Toss to catch her again after she dashes.
Sejuani.escape: Right after you make Sejuani use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is your opening to engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Sejuani has already used the stun from Sejuani E Permafrost, its stacks will not build again for a short time, but keep your distance from the basic attack immediately after the stun, which deals bonus damage based on maximum health.
Sejuani.phase: Sejuani also has low early kill and damage numbers, leaving room to safely look for control and objective opportunities.
Sejuani.teamfight: Secure vision in the narrow paths around objectives first, then land Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy on grouped enemies when your team is ready to follow. If Sejuani engages to lock down an allied damage dealer, you can use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy on Sejuani alone instead of waiting to catch several enemies. After engaging, activate Amumu W Despair and stay near the enemy frontline.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on health alone to survive. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so use Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy after she lands. Do not start an objective first if Shyvana's Fury bar is full.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Build armor as well for her basic attacks. If the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis is a problem, fit Morellonomicon between core items and maintain its Grievous Wounds effect with Amumu W Despair.
Shyvana.fight: Lock Shyvana down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss before she gets close enough to deal damage, and fight alongside your team. If Shyvana can use Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, do not use both casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss in succession; save one to catch her again after she moves away. Once close, deal sustained damage and maintain the curse with Amumu W Despair.
Shyvana.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health on his first jungle clear, so do not force a solo invade against Shyvana. Clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly to save mana.
Shyvana.combo: The standard engage is Amumu Q Bandage Toss, followed by Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks, in that order. If Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is available, save one cast of Amumu Q Bandage Toss to catch her again after she moves.
Shyvana.escape: Pressure Shyvana or start an objective when her Fury bar is empty. After Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is used, she cannot use it to create distance, giving you a chance to catch her with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Counterattack when she returns from dragon form to human form and loses the bonus health and empowered abilities.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana's permanent stacks make the matchup less favorable over time, so take gank and objective opportunities early, then teamfight with your allies in the mid and late game.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so your team does not all get hit by the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and the area damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst. If Shyvana dives an allied damage dealer, protect them by locking her down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy after she lands. In narrow paths around objectives, engage when your team is ready to follow, then keep Amumu W Despair active and stay near the enemy frontline.

Shaco.watch: Watch for fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives, and clear boxes beforehand with Control Wards and Oracle Lens. If you kill the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate, retreat immediately to avoid its explosion and boxes. When low on health, avoid paths without vision so Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison cannot hit you.
Shaco.build: Get Control Wards to clear boxes first, and prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Build health too, to avoid the low-health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Magic resistance does not protect against the physical damage from Shaco Q Deceive.
Shaco.fight: Rather than chasing Shaco alone, Amumu should keep his distance and wait for a chance to catch him with his team. When Shaco appears after using Shaco Q Deceive, he cannot immediately use it again to escape. Lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy and focus him with your team.
Shaco.laning: In the early jungle, clear camps with Amumu E Tantrum and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly to save mana. Do not force an invade on your first clear; maintain vision at the entrances to your jungle to prepare for Shaco's early ganks and invades.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco Q Deceive is used, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy while Shaco is stunned. Then use Amumu E Tantrum, activate Amumu W Despair, and basic attack. If both casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss are available, save one for Shaco's escape instead of using them back to back.
Shaco.escape: Right after Shaco enters with Shaco Q Deceive and reveals himself is Amumu's opening to engage and catch him. Secure vision and clear boxes along paths likely to hold Shaco W Jack In The Box before entering; do not engage while feared.
Shaco.phase: Amumu is weak early and loses a lot of health on his first jungle clear, while Shaco looks for advantages through ganks and invades. Avoid giving up early kills, take objectives, and buy time to use Amumu's strengths in mid and late game teamfights.
Shaco.teamfight: Clear boxes around objectives first. When enemies group in a narrow path and your team is ready to follow, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Shaco jumps onto an ally with Shaco Q Deceive, locking down Shaco alone with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is also a good way to protect your damage dealer. After engaging, activate Amumu W Despair and stay near the frontline, but move away from the spot where a clone from Shaco R Hallucinate dies.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah cannot change the direction of Taliyah Q Threaded Volley while casting it, so sidestep instead of approaching in a straight line. Avoid engaging with Amumu Q Bandage Toss across the rock field.
Taliyah.build: If you are locked down by Taliyah W Seismic Shove followed by Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, you have no ability to escape, so get tenacity first. Then build magic resistance against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth.
Taliyah.fight: Do not throw Amumu Q Bandage Toss straight into Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Find a side angle around the rock field. If you reach Taliyah, Amumu's magic damage works well against her low magic resistance, so attack while the stuns continue.
Taliyah.laning: Avoid a forced invade on your first jungle clear, and turn off Amumu W Despair while moving to save mana. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, watch for her to reach other lanes with Taliyah P Rock Surfing and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.combo: When you have an angle that avoids the rock field, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and continue the stun with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Then use Amumu E Tantrum, activate Amumu W Despair, and weave in basic attacks. Space out the two casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss instead of using them back to back, so you can catch Taliyah again if she escapes.
Taliyah.escape: Do not engage immediately just because either Taliyah E Unraveled Earth or Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is down. In particular, before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back, look for an angle to land Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy while avoiding the rock field. If Taliyah W Seismic Shove is also down, there is less risk of being caught by its forced movement.
Taliyah.phase: Look for teamfights with your allies in the mid and late game. Amumu has weak solo combat, so do not fight alone in a side lane.
Taliyah.teamfight: Secure objective vision first. When enemies group as they enter a narrow path, look for a flank with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Flash followed by Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Before engaging, check where Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is placed so you do not cross the rock field. Go in when your team is ready to follow, then activate Amumu W Despair and stay near the enemy frontline.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede lets him close in quickly and stun you, so keep your distance right after he activates the stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on health alone to survive a long fight. Crowd control that prevents movement does not work during the empowered Udyr E Blazing Stampede; use Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy after the empowerment ends.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so one resistance cannot block it all. If Udyr sustains through Udyr W Iron Mantle, build Morellonomicon between core items and maintain Grievous Wounds with Amumu W Despair.
Udyr.fight: Your chance to press the attack comes when the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone and he has just used Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Close in and stun him with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then stay beside him with Amumu W Despair active to deal damage. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already stunned you, use the period when it cannot stun the same target again to counterattack or disengage.
Udyr.laning: Early on, ward jungle entrances and key routes to track Udyr, and avoid risky invades when he is out of sight. Amumu loses a lot of health on his first jungle clear, so clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly.
Udyr.combo: After the empowerment of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attacks. Use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy before Amumu E Tantrum so allies can attack during the stun. Do not use both casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss in succession; if Udyr creates distance with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, catch him again with the remaining cast.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is his way to move, so right after he uses it is Amumu's chance to go in. If it stuns you once, you can counterattack or disengage while it cannot stun the same target again. Save Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy during Udyr's awakening, then use them after the awakening ends to stop Udyr's fast movement.
Udyr.phase: In the mid and late game, play around teamfights. Your solo fighting is weak, so do not fight Udyr alone in a side lane.
Udyr.teamfight: Set up vision in narrow paths around objectives before the fight, and engage when the enemies, including Udyr, group up and your allies can follow. Do not force attacks onto Udyr alone once defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle make him durable; target a vulnerable enemy behind him first. If Udyr dives your damage dealer, using Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down Udyr alone is also a good choice.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain and stuns on collision with a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale can drag a suppressed target across terrain, so keep your distance, especially at the edge of an objective pit. Stay out of reach before he catches you so he cannot chain empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.fight: Right after you make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and fight. Once close, deal damage based on maximum health with Amumu W Despair and add area damage with Amumu E Tantrum. Engage when allies can fight with you so you do not take empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval for too long.
Skarner.laning: Your first jungle clear costs a lot of health, so do not make risky invades into Skarner's jungle. Clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, activate Amumu W Despair only briefly to save mana, and turn it off while moving.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and follow with the stun from Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Then use Amumu E Tantrum, activate Amumu W Despair, and weave in basic attacks. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, do not use both casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss in succession; use the second to catch him again if he escapes after the first.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down is your window to engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. If Skarner R Impale is available, he can suppress you after you engage, so watch the distance between Skarner and his allies.
Skarner.phase: In the mid to late game, play for teamfights. Once Skarner has tank items, he can hold you in place while dealing damage, so avoid fighting him alone.
Skarner.teamfight: Set up vision around dragon or Baron in advance, and look to land Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy when enemies gather in a narrow path. If Skarner dives your damage dealer, it may be better to lock him down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy than to aim for several enemies. A stun cannot interrupt the suppression from Skarner R Impale, so act before it begins.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you may need to remove Skarner R Impale; if so, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Then build magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.

Vi.watch: When Vi starts charging Vi Q Vault Breaker, back away or move sideways to dodge it. Vi R Cease and Desist follows its target all the way, so do not try to dodge it with Flash. Respond with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy after she lands and the knockup ends.
Vi.build: Vi's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only a large health pool and consider an attack speed slow.
Vi.fight: Do not rush a damage trade while Vi P Blast Shield is active. Make her use Vi Q Vault Breaker, then close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss for a short fight. Create distance before Vi W Denting Blows benefits from repeated attacks.
Vi.laning: In the early jungle, clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly during fights and jungle clearing.
Vi.combo: After Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, follow with the stun from Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, then attack with Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attacks. If Vi Q Vault Breaker is available, do not use both casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss in succession; use the second to catch her again when she escapes.
Vi.escape: Right after you make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker is Amumu's chance to engage. If she targets an ally with Vi R Cease and Desist, do not use Amumu's crowd control while she is charging in. Lock her down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy after she lands and the knockup ends.
Vi.phase: Your solo fighting is weak, so do not fight Vi alone in a side lane.
Vi.teamfight: Set up vision in narrow paths around objectives before the fight, and use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down several enemies when your allies are ready to follow. If Vi R Cease and Desist targets your damage dealer, locking down Vi alone with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy after she lands and the knockup ends is also a good choice. After engaging, activate Amumu W Despair and stay beside the enemy frontline to fight.

Viego.watch: The longer Viego charges Viego W Spectral Maw, the longer its stun lasts. Dodge sideways when you see him charging it, and interrupt it with Amumu Q Bandage Toss if possible. Viego may be camouflaged in the black mist created by Viego E Harrowed Path, so avoid that route. Back away when your health is low, as you may become a target for Viego R Heartbreaker.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If fights run long because of the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, build Morellonomicon between core items after getting resistances.
Viego.fight: Amumu's solo fighting is weak, so do not fight Viego alone for long. Even after Viego W Spectral Maw is down, do not rush to engage if Viego R Heartbreaker is available. When allies are ready to fight with you, stay close and keep dealing damage with Amumu W Despair and Amumu E Tantrum.
Viego.laning: Early on, save mana during jungle clears by activating Amumu W Despair only briefly, and avoid risky invades. If you see mist from Viego E Harrowed Path, be alert so you do not push the lane toward it.
Viego.combo: Land Amumu Q Bandage Toss on Viego to close in, then follow with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attacks. Do not use both casts of Amumu Q Bandage Toss in succession; if Viego escapes with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker, catch him again with the remaining cast.
Viego.escape: If only Viego W Spectral Maw is down, do not rush to engage: he can still escape with Viego R Heartbreaker. In particular, before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up, lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy once Viego W Spectral Maw is also down. You can also interrupt Viego W Spectral Maw while he is charging it with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Viego.phase: Retreat from fights you cannot win so Viego does not get a kill.
Viego.teamfight: Set up vision in narrow paths around dragon or Baron, and land Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy on grouped enemies when your allies are ready to follow. You can also use it on Viego alone if you need to lock him down while he targets your damage dealer. If an ally falls, use Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to keep Viego from reaching the wraith at that spot, and move away from where the ally fell.

Warwick.watch: Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position when your health falls below half and increases Warwick's movement and attack speed. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, back off instead of committing your damage, then reengage after the fear triggers. You cannot act while suppressed by Warwick R Infinite Duress, so do not treat the distance between a Warwick with increased movement speed and an area without vision as a safe distance.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress.
Warwick.fight: Amumu has no escape ability, so keep your distance to avoid being caught by Warwick first. Back off while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then reengage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss after the fear triggers. Warwick can survive by healing even at low health, so do not dive based on his health alone.
Warwick.laning: Amumu loses a lot of health during early jungle clears, so do not force an invade into Warwick's jungle on your first clear. Clear camps primarily with Amumu E Tantrum. Use Amumu W Despair briefly to conserve mana, and turn it off while moving.
Warwick.combo: The standard engage is Amumu Q Bandage Toss → Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → activate Amumu W Despair → basic attack. If Warwick escapes with Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or Warwick R Infinite Duress, catch him again with your saved second Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Do not start this combo while Warwick E Primal Howl is active.
Warwick.escape: The window to engage is before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. If only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, account for his remaining Warwick R Infinite Duress. After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers, lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Warwick.phase: Teamfights are Amumu's strength in the mid and late game, but his solo fighting is weak, so do not fight Warwick alone in a side lane.
Warwick.teamfight: Establish vision around objectives first, then look for Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy as the enemy enters a narrow passage. If Warwick R Infinite Duress catches an allied damage dealer, stunning Warwick in place with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is also a good way to protect them. Engage when your allies are ready to follow up, then stay among the frontline with Amumu W Despair active.

XinZhao.watch: Sidestep the thrust on the second part of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If two empowered basic attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike have hit you, create distance before the third hit knocks you up. After Xin Zhao closes in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, watch for the slow and follow up attacks.
XinZhao.build: Most of Xin Zhao's damage is physical, so build armor first. Add Morellonomicon between core items to counter the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard deals damage based on current health, so stacking health alone is less effective.
XinZhao.fight: Amumu has no escape ability, so do not engage first and commit to a long fight while Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is available. Sidestep the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then lock him down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy right after he uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Once close, activate Amumu W Despair to deal damage, but turn it off while moving to save mana.
XinZhao.laning: In the early jungle, clear camps with Amumu E Tantrum and use Amumu W Despair briefly. Do not force an invade on the first clear after health has been reduced. After Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, look for a chance to catch him with Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
XinZhao.combo: Once you confirm Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attack. Do not use both charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss immediately. If Xin Zhao may escape with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, save one to catch him again.
XinZhao.escape: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is his mobility tool, so the moment after you make him use it is your window to engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Dodging the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning also removes his angle to engage with the extended range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Before the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike lands, prioritize creating distance over engaging.
XinZhao.phase: Amumu is weak early and loses a lot of health while clearing, so avoid fighting Xin Zhao alone. In the mid and late game, teamfights become Amumu's strength as he gains items, so move with your allies instead of fighting alone.
XinZhao.teamfight: If Xin Zhao dives an allied damage dealer, protect them by reliably locking down Xin Zhao alone with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Do not stand too close to your allies, so the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard does not split your formation. Look for a chance to focus him after his damage immunity ends. In narrow passages around objectives, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy when your allies are ready to follow up.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot can launch him from behind a wall and knock you up, so move away when you see him charging it or interrupt him with Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Amumu has no escape ability and can also be caught by Zac Q Stretching Strikes, making it easy to take follow up hits once caught. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid staying close and taking repeated hits.
Zac.build: Add Morellonomicon between core items to counter the healing from Zac P Cell Division. The damage over time from Amumu W Despair can maintain Grievous Wounds. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Zac's damage.
Zac.fight: Make Zac use Zac E Elastic Slingshot first, then close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss after his jump is down. Once close, use Amumu W Despair to deal damage based on maximum health, and step on the blobs Zac drops to deny his healing. Amumu's solo fighting is weak, so do not fight alone for long.
Zac.laning: In the early jungle, clear primarily with Amumu E Tantrum and use Amumu W Despair briefly to save mana. Avoid forcing an invade on your first clear because it costs a lot of health.
Zac.combo: If Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, close in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss → Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → Amumu W Despair → basic attack. If Zac escapes with Zac E Elastic Slingshot after the first Amumu Q Bandage Toss, catch him again with the saved second charge. You can also interrupt Zac E Elastic Slingshot while he is charging it with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Zac.escape: The moment after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used is Amumu's chance to engage. Keep your distance while Zac still has ways to catch you, since Amumu has no escape ability.
Zac.phase: Amumu is weak early and loses a lot of health on his first jungle clear, so do not force an engage on Zac. Teamfights are Amumu's strength in the mid and late game, but avoid fighting Zac alone in a side lane.
Zac.teamfight: Wait on a flank outside enemy vision. After interrupting or absorbing Zac E Elastic Slingshot's engage, use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy when your allies can follow up. If Zac catches an allied damage dealer, it can also be worth stunning Zac alone reliably instead of trying to hit several enemies. After engaging, activate Amumu W Despair and stay near the frontline. When Zac splits up to revive, use the area damage from Amumu E Tantrum to deal with the blobs once they have gathered.

Belveth.watch: If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits you, it knocks you up and allows a cooldown reset. When Bel'Veth closes in, turn sideways to dodge it instead of running straight back. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces incoming damage while active, so save damage abilities such as Amumu E Tantrum until it ends. Watch out for the healing and missing-health-based true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage, so build armor first. Build health as well to survive the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.fight: Do not pour damage into Bel'Veth while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active. Once it ends, lock her down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, then attack with your team. If she escapes with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, catch her again with your saved second Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Avoid fighting her alone.
Belveth.laning: On your first jungle clear, use Amumu E Tantrum to clear camps and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly to manage your health and mana.
Belveth.combo: After Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, engage with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, immediately use Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, then follow with Amumu E Tantrum, Amumu W Despair, and basic attacks, in that order. Bel'Veth can create distance with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, so do not use both charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss at once.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below sideways to prevent a cooldown reset, then look for an opening to engage. Even after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is used, it comes back quickly, so chain Amumu Q Bandage Toss into Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock her down before she can use it again. Keep a second Amumu Q Bandage Toss ready in case she moves with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.phase: As the game goes on, stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender put you at a disadvantage. Prepare for teamfights with your allies instead of fighting alone.
Belveth.teamfight: Establish vision in the narrow paths around objectives, and hit multiple enemies with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy when your team can follow up. If Bel'Veth dives your team's damage dealer, locking her down with Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy may be more valuable. If an ally falls and drops Void Coral, back away before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay the teamfight while her transformation is active.

Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne can quickly follow along its trail. Do not run in a straight line; turn toward your allies or a turret. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, create distance to break it before the fear triggers. When Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, do not immediately use Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. Armor does not protect against the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Nocturne sustains through healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, fit Morellonomicon between core items and use Amumu W Despair to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Nocturne.fight: Amumu is weak in solo fights, so do not fight Nocturne alone for long. After Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, close in and stun him with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then lock him down with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy when your allies can attack. Once in range, activate Amumu W Despair and weave in basic attacks to maintain damage and the curse.
Nocturne.laning: In the early jungle, clear camps mainly with Amumu E Tantrum, and activate Amumu W Despair only briefly to save mana. Avoid forcing an invade into Nocturne’s jungle during your first clear, when you lose a lot of health.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, first remove the shield with a skill such as Amumu E Tantrum. Then use Amumu Q Bandage Toss to close in → Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy → Amumu E Tantrum → activate Amumu W Despair → basic attack. Do not use both charges of Amumu Q Bandage Toss at once; save one to catch Nocturne again if he repositions with Nocturne R Paranoia.
Nocturne.escape: Remove Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before stunning him, and create distance to break the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.phase: Amumu is weak early and loses a lot of health on his first jungle clear, so avoid risky invades. Amumu grows strong in teamfights in the mid and late game, but do not fight alone, and stay close to your allies while Nocturne R Paranoia is available.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, stay close to your allies so no one is isolated. If Nocturne dives onto an allied damage dealer, using Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to lock down Nocturne alone is also a good option. When engaging first, position on the side of narrow terrain and look for the moment when your allies are ready to follow up. Strip Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before using Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
